facts.text: Salvage law awards a restarter's contract to a dead Frame's owner when restart happens mid-duel on onboard power.
League officials log restart timestamps live and deny protests once a lock breaks and a Frame revives.
Harrow Wing is a rival sponsor wing that ambushes Vixen Flight four-on-one and loses.
Vixen Flight keeps a shared bunk with a blank schedule board for Ren's nights.
Rival wings flash buyout bids for Ren on optics during and after duels.

notes.text: Ren Tojo's contract chip is pressed to Mira Kaine and he bunks in the Vixen bunk starting tonight.
Ren Tojo suffers nosebleeds, pulse spikes, and sync burns when he holds high sync.
Ren Tojo wears an oversized borrowed hangar spare plug suit that gaps and splits.
Ren Tojo is owed lead's share, dinner, and a towel by Mira Kaine for restarting her first.
Mira Kaine holds Ren Tojo's salvage contract slate as Vixen lead and anchor Frame.
Mira Kaine claims Monday and Friday nights with Ren Tojo on the schedule board.
Sable Voss claims Ren Tojo's first towel-off and starts collecting it.
Sable Voss is owed dinner and a night by Ren Tojo for going dark twice.
Juno Hale wagers her towel-off and Harrow drift patterns for Ren Tojo's sync.
Juno Hale holds intercepted Harrow scout chatter and a log of rival bids for Ren Tojo.
Tessa Rook rewrites the bunk board to place Ren Tojo near her with mandatory rest breaks.
Tessa Rook monitors Ren Tojo's pulse and sync burns after each link.
Harrow Wing loses its kill lock on Vixen Flight and has its protest and appeal denied.
Harrow Wing flashes a buyout bid for Ren Tojo on optics.
League Official finalizes Ren Tojo's salvage custody to Mira Kaine for one restarted Frame.

plotlines.name: Custody Schedule War
plotlines.summary: Four pilots fight over who gets Ren for calibration, towel-offs, and sleepovers, with a whiteboard schedule that never survives the episode.

plotlines.name: Road Back to Ace
plotlines.summary: Vixen Flight must grind from bottom-tier exhibitions back to ace rank, but they can only field full power when Ren picks who he syncs with.

plotlines.name: Poach Season
plotlines.summary: Rival wings file buyouts, issue duel wagers for Ren's nights, and send honey-trap pilots to lure him into breaking contract.

plotlines.name: Sync Freak Mystery
plotlines.summary: Ren syncs with anyone but burns out fast, and his black-market implant scar suggests someone built him to be shared.

continuity_rules.text: A salvage restart must use the dead Frame's own onboard starter charge through an open hatch with no outside power.
Ren spikes past 90% sync with any Vixen pilot and must unlink fast to avoid nosebleed and nerve burn.
A revived pilot resumes solo control immediately after Ren unlinks.
A forfeited duel drops rank and loses sponsors that night.

overall_plotline.name: Shared Property Contract
overall_plotline.summary: Ren's salvage-law contract makes him the legal property and sole co-pilot of Vixen Flight, forcing four rivalrous women to share his body, schedule, and sync in every duel, bath, and bunk dispute while rivals try to steal him.
